def solve_cvrp(instance):
    depot = instance["depot_index"]
    customers = list(instance["customer_ids"])
    demands = instance["demands"]
    capacity = instance["capacity"]
    d = instance["distance_matrix"]

    n = len(customers)
    if n == 0:
        return []

    # Feasible savings-based construction with deterministic tie-breaking
    route_of = {}
    routes = []
    loads = []
    for i in customers:
        route_of[i] = len(routes)
        routes.append([i])
        loads.append(demands[i])

    def route_total(rt):
        if not rt:
            return 0
        tot = d[depot][rt[0]] + d[rt[-1]][depot]
        for k in range(len(rt) - 1):
            tot += d[rt[k]][rt[k + 1]]
        return tot

    # Compute savings for all pairs
    savings = []
    for a_idx in range(n):
        a = customers[a_idx]
        da = d[depot][a]
        for b_idx in range(a_idx + 1, n):
            b = customers[b_idx]
            s = da + d[depot][b] - d[a][b]
            # deterministic tie-breaking: higher savings, then smaller nodes
            savings.append((s, a, b))
    savings.sort(key=lambda x: (-x[0], x[1], x[2]))

    # Merge if endpoints can be connected (deterministic best orientation)
    for s, i, j in savings:
        ri = route_of.get(i, None)
        rj = route_of.get(j, None)
        if ri is None or rj is None or ri == rj:
            continue
        r1 = routes[ri]
        r2 = routes[rj]

        # positions: only allow i at start/end of its route and j at start/end of its route
        i_at_start = bool(r1 and r1[0] == i)
        i_at_end = bool(r1 and r1[-1] == i)
        j_at_start = bool(r2 and r2[0] == j)
        j_at_end = bool(r2 and r2[-1] == j)
        if not (i_at_start or i_at_end) or not (j_at_start or j_at_end):
            continue

        if loads[ri] + loads[rj] > capacity:
            continue

        best = None  # (dist, new_route)
        # Candidate 1: i end, j start => r1 + r2
        if i_at_end and j_at_start:
            cand = r1 + r2
            bestd = d[depot][cand[0]] + d[cand[-1]][depot]
            for k in range(len(cand) - 1):
                bestd += d[cand[k]][cand[k + 1]]
            best = (bestd, cand)
        # Candidate 2: i start, j end => rev(r1) + r2
        if i_at_start and j_at_end:
            cand = list(reversed(r1)) + r2
            bestd = d[depot][cand[0]] + d[cand[-1]][depot]
            for k in range(len(cand) - 1):
                bestd += d[cand[k]][cand[k + 1]]
            if best is None or bestd < best[0]:
                best = (bestd, cand)
        # Candidate 3: i end, j end => r1 + rev(r2)
        if i_at_end and j_at_end:
            cand = r1 + list(reversed(r2))
            bestd = d[depot][cand[0]] + d[cand[-1]][depot]
            for k in range(len(cand) - 1):
                bestd += d[cand[k]][cand[k + 1]]
            if best is None or bestd < best[0]:
                best = (bestd, cand)
        # Candidate 4: i start, j start => rev(r1) + rev(r2)
        if i_at_start and j_at_start:
            cand = list(reversed(r1)) + list(reversed(r2))
            bestd = d[depot][cand[0]] + d[cand[-1]][depot]
            for k in range(len(cand) - 1):
                bestd += d[cand[k]][cand[k + 1]]
            if best is None or bestd < best[0]:
                best = (bestd, cand)

        if best is None:
            continue

        new_rt = best[1]
        routes[ri] = new_rt
        loads[ri] = loads[ri] + loads[rj]
        routes[rj] = []
        loads[rj] = 0
        # Update route_of mapping for all customers in rj
        for node in r2:
            route_of[node] = ri

    # Filter empty routes
    routes = [rt for rt in routes if rt]
    loads = [sum(demands[x] for x in rt) for rt in routes]

    # Intra-route 2-opt (deterministic first-improvement with tight limits)
    for ri in range(len(routes)):
        rt = routes[ri]
        m = len(rt)
        if m <= 3:
            continue
        cur = route_total(rt)
        improved = True
        while improved:
            improved = False
            m = len(rt)
            for a in range(m - 2):
                for b in range(a + 2, m):
                    new_rt = rt[:a + 1] + list(reversed(rt[a + 1:b + 1])) + rt[b + 1:]
                    new_cost = route_total(new_rt)
                    if new_cost < cur:
                        rt = new_rt
                        cur = new_cost
                        improved = True
                        break
                if improved:
                    break
        routes[ri] = rt

    # Inter-route relocate: move one customer into another route with best (minimal gain; accept only improving)
    max_passes = 8
    for _ in range(max_passes):
        if len(routes) <= 1:
            break
        route_of = {}
        for idx, rt in enumerate(routes):
            for node in rt:
                route_of[node] = idx

        best_move = None  # (gain, from_r, to_r, pos_from, ins_pos, new_from, new_to)

        for from_r in range(len(routes)):
            rt_from = routes[from_r]
            if not rt_from:
                continue
            cur_cost_from = route_total(rt_from)
            if not rt_from:
                continue
            for pos in range(len(rt_from)):
                node = rt_from[pos]
                load_node = demands[node]
                # Deterministic scan order for target routes
                for to_r in range(len(routes)):
                    if to_r == from_r:
                        continue
                    if loads[to_r] + load_node > capacity:
                        continue
                    rt_to = routes[to_r]
                    cur_cost_to = route_total(rt_to)
                    # Try all insertion positions
                    for ins in range(len(rt_to) + 1):
                        new_from = rt_from[:pos] + rt_from[pos + 1:]
                        new_to = rt_to[:ins] + [node] + rt_to[ins:]
                        new_cost_from = route_total(new_from) if new_from else 0
                        new_cost_to = route_total(new_to) if new_to else 0
                        gain = (cur_cost_from + cur_cost_to) - (new_cost_from + new_cost_to)
                        if gain > 0:
                            cand = (gain, from_r, to_r, pos, ins, new_from, new_to)
                            if best_move is None or gain > best_move[0]:
                                best_move = cand
                            elif gain == best_move[0]:
                                # deterministic tie-break
                                if (from_r, to_r, pos, ins) < (best_move[1], best_move[2], best_move[3], best_move[4]):
                                    best_move = cand
        if best_move is None:
            break

        gain, from_r, to_r, pos, ins, new_from, new_to = best_move
        routes[from_r] = new_from
        routes[to_r] = new_to
        if new_from:
            loads[from_r] = sum(demands[x] for x in new_from)
        else:
            routes[from_r] = []
            loads[from_r] = 0
        if new_to:
            loads[to_r] = sum(demands[x] for x in new_to)
        else:
            routes[to_r] = []
            loads[to_r] = 0
        # cleanup empties early to keep indices stable next pass
        if any(not rt for rt in routes):
            new_routes = []
            new_loads = []
            for rt in routes:
                if rt:
                    new_routes.append(rt)
                    new_loads.append(sum(demands[x] for x in rt))
            routes, loads = new_routes, new_loads

    # Inter-route swap (1-for-1) with feasibility and best improving gain
    # Deterministic: first best improving among all candidate pairs within modest route sizes
    improved = True
    swap_pass_limit = 6
    pass_no = 0
    while improved and pass_no < swap_pass_limit:
        pass_no += 1
        improved = False
        if len(routes) <= 1:
            break
        best_swap = None  # (gain, r1, r2, p1, p2, new_r1, new_r2)

        for r1 in range(len(routes)):
            rt1 = routes[r1]
            if len(rt1) == 0:
                continue
            cost1 = route_total(rt1)
            if len(rt1) > 40:
                # keep compute bounded on very large routes
                continue
            for r2 in range(r1 + 1, len(routes)):
                rt2 = routes[r2]
                if len(rt2) == 0:
                    continue
                if len(rt2) > 40:
                    continue
                cost2 = route_total(rt2)
                # swap any pair, deterministic order
                for p1 in range(len(rt1)):
                    a = rt1[p1]
                    da = demands[a]
                    for p2 in range(len(rt2)):
                        b = rt2[p2]
                        db = demands[b]
                        if loads[r1] - da + db > capacity:
                            continue
                        if loads[r2] - db + da > capacity:
                            continue
                        new_rt1 = rt1[:p1] + [b] + rt1[p1 + 1:]
                        new_rt2 = rt2[:p2] + [a] + rt2[p2 + 1:]
                        new_cost1 = route_total(new_rt1)
                        new_cost2 = route_total(new_rt2)
                        gain = (cost1 + cost2) - (new_cost1 + new_cost2)
                        if gain > 0:
                            cand = (gain, r1, r2, p1, p2, new_rt1, new_rt2)
                            if best_swap is None or gain > best_swap[0]:
                                best_swap = cand
                            elif gain == best_swap[0]:

            routes[r1] = new_rt1
            routes[r2] = new_rt2
            loads[r1] = sum(demands[x] for x in new_rt1)
            loads[r2] = sum(demands[x] for x in new_rt2)
            improved = True

    # Final cleanup
    routes = [rt for rt in routes if rt]
    return routes
